finding: Sexual activity during pregnancy was associated with improved labor outcomes, including shorter labor stages, higher rates of spontaneous delivery, and lower rates of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women who were sexually active during pregnancy had a lower rate of caesarean sections (RR = 0.46; CI = 0.1-0.8).
